On MathVision (Table 2, page 15), **Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B (thinking) scores 74.6** and **Gemini 2.5 Pro (thinking) scores 73.3**, so Qwen3-VL leads by 1.3 points. The asterisk on Gemini's 73.3 means the value comes from Gemini's own technical report rather than the Qwen team's evaluation (page 15).

The non-thinking variants in the same table are Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B Instruct at 66.5 and Gemini 2.5 Pro (budget-128) at 66.0 (page 15).

On the separate MathVision-Wildphoto variant, the thinking scores are 63.8 for Qwen3-VL and 63.2 for Gemini 2.5 Pro (page 15).

The report also says Qwen3-VL-235B-A22B-Thinking achieves state-of-the-art results on MathVision (page 14).
